blocks.task_summary: Find the area of one shaded circular segment in terms of θ, given radius 2 cm and angle θ.
method_path: Area of segment = area of sector − area of triangle

evidence.basis: valid approach to find area of segment by finding area of sector – area of triangle (M1); ½r²θ − ½r²sinθ; ½(2)²θ − ½(2)²sinθ (A1); area = 2θ − 2sinθ A1

blocks.task_summary: Given logo area = 13.4 cm², formed by removing two equal segments from a 5×4 cm rectangle, find θ using GDC.
accepted_alternatives: Find area of one segment = (20 − 13.4)/2 = 3.3, solve 2θ − 2sinθ = 3.3 using GDC, θ = 2.36

evidence.basis: EITHER area of logo = area of rectangle – area of segments (M1); 5×4 − 2×(2θ−2sinθ) = 13.4 (A1); OR area of one segment = (20−13.4)/2 = 3.3 (M1); 2θ−2sinθ = 3.3 (A1); THEN θ = 2.35672...; θ = 2.36 (do not accept an answer in degrees) A1
